_comment: The world's events for a server lived alone (Managers.WorldHappenings): a roaming boss cried across
the server, and the zone of the hour. Nothing happens, nothing is cried, while no real player is
in the world; the simulated players do not count.
enabled              false turns everything off
bosses.enabled       the roaming bosses
bosses.minMinutes    the wait between two bosses is drawn between these two, in minutes
bosses.maxMinutes
bosses.firstAfterMinutes  the wait before the first one, after the server starts
bosses.lifetimeMinutes    how long one stays on its map if nobody beats it
bosses.levelSpread   its map is an outdoor map of the world map whose subarea's level is at
most this far from the boss's «level»
bosses.sighted       the lines cried, {name} the boss's name, {zone} the subarea and [x,y];
bosses.beaten        «beaten» when its group left its map before its time (a fight won against
bosses.gone          it), «gone» when its time ran out. Each boss can carry its own three.
bosses.list          monster   the leader's MonsterTemplates id
grade     its grade, 0-based (0 is the first)
level     the level its map's subarea is matched against
name      its French name, as the lines cry it
escort    [ { monster, grade } ] who comes with it
zones.enabled        the zone of the hour: an open anomaly's subarea -- the ones that really pay
zones.everyMinutes   +120% experience and loot -- put forward in turn, every so many minutes.
zones.text           {zone} the subarea, {bonus} the bonus. bonus_zones.json is only the
panel's list, with no bonus of its own: it is not what rotates.
Ids from world.db (names there are Spanish): 147 Jalató Real (Bouftou Royal, 30) with 101 Jalató
and 134 Jalatín blanco; 382 Tofu Real (120) with 98 Tofu; 113 Dragocerdo (Dragocochon, 100); 928
Mob Lasponja (Mob l'Éponge, 20); the archmonsters 2416 Bwarkgner (Bwork's, 50) with 876 Bwork and
2336 Mashkira (Moskito's, 20) with 61 Moskito. The archmonsters' French names are not in the data:
they are cried by what they are.
